summary_out.changed: Replaced the base algo's unconditional 'skip OPEN while a position is in-flight' serialize gate with a portfolio-equity circuit breaker: track cumulative realized P&L of closed positions and its running peak, skip OPEN legs only while realized P&L is more than drawdown_halt (150 USD) below that peak.
summary_out.outcome: pnl +71.6% vs base position-tier-gate (-1675.25 vs -5892.25), slippage 0.0% (both 0.0), sharpe -106.02; max_drawdown improved ~84% (-0.099% to -0.015%); still FAILs the config pass gate vs simple baseline (+156).
summary_out.hypothesis: The base algo's blanket throttle skips opens all the time and that skipped subset is net-negative under the high-noise sigma=200 oracle; conditioning the throttle on realized-P&L drawdown should behave like simple on flat-to-up stretches (capturing upside) while cutting exposure only during genuine losing streaks.
summary_out.next: The breaker latches one-way: once realized P&L drops below the all-time session peak it never re-arms under sigma=200, collapsing trade_count to 32k (76% below simple) and distorting Sharpe. Highest-leverage next change: make the breaker re-arm — use a rolling/decaying drawdown reference instead of an all-time peak, or resume opens once P&L recovers a fraction of the drawdown, or add a cooldown-then-retry so the algo samples fresh signals after a halt. Also tune drawdown_halt; 150 USD may engage too early.
